facts.claim: A quiet, middle-aged G-type star, yellow-white
facts.justification: the art fixes a yellow-white sun and a blue sky; a K dwarf would give an orange sky

facts.claim: Surface gravity a little above Earth's
facts.justification: council range 1.05-1.15 g; to be fixed in the planet canon

facts.claim: A day of about 26-27 hours with long twilights
facts.justification: tidal braking by a large moon
sound carries far and echoes are long; slower falls; drag caps sprint speeds
large bodies and costly organs (glow, sonar) are affordable

facts.claim: A large, close, bright moon; strong tides; month about 30 days
facts.justification: bright moonlit nights favour sight hunters; moonless nights are truly dark

facts.claim: An active volcanic hotspot built the island
facts.justification: explains the stratovolcano, warm ground, mineral licks and lava tubes
cold sea air over warm volcanic ground under dense air

facts.claim: Old lava-tube caves and a cave behind a waterfall
facts.justification: drained lava flows from the hotspot (F7); erosion behind the falls

changelog.what: draft facts from the council's planet drafts; replaced by the merged planet canon
